socket.socketIoPath: Label of the Socket.IO engine path field. Short.
socket.socketIoAuth: Label of the field for the Socket.IO authentication payload.
socket.statuses.waiting: Connection state: the connection was lost and a new attempt is scheduled.
socket.entries.sent: Log entry type: a message that was sent. Accessible label of an icon.
socket.entries.received: Log entry type: a message that was received. Accessible label of an icon.
socket.entries.info: Log entry type: information about the connection. Accessible label of an icon.
socket.protocol: Accessible label of the picker for the protocol spoken over the socket.
socket.graphql: Label shown instead of the protocol picker for GraphQL requests over WebSocket.
socket.filter: Placeholder and label of the MQTT topic filter field; sensors/# is an example filter.
socket.subscribe: Button that subscribes to an MQTT topic filter.
socket.saved: Accessible label of the picker of saved messages.
socket.save: Button that saves the draft message. Short.
socket.saveTitle: Title of the dialog that asks for a name for a message.
socket.remove: Accessible label of the button that deletes a saved message.
socket.binary: Note under a received binary message. {{count}} is the number of bytes.
socket.dropped: {{dropped}} and {{limit}} are numbers of log entries.
socket.unsentHeaders: {{names}} is a list of header names. Sec-WebSocket-Protocol is an HTTP header name.
socket.composer: Placeholder of the message box. {{shortcut}} is a keyboard shortcut such as Ctrl+Enter.
socket.message: Accessible label of the message box.
socket.send: Button that sends the message. Short.
socket.clear: Button that empties the message log. Short.
socket.log: Accessible label of the list of messages.
socket.entries.warning: Label of a warning entry in the WebSocket message log.
socket.entries.error: Label of an error entry in the WebSocket message log.
